purpose: Test whether feeding the first complete route-pool recombination back into a final mechanism-aware HGS search produces genuine endpoint improvement at the same total budgets.
control: Current archive-route-reuse MV-HGS-SP with 5000 iterations and 24 completed archive candidates in each of three views.
candidate: Each view scouts for 4000 iterations with 16 completed archive candidates. Their routes are recombined once. The recombined solution and the best distinct complete solutions then warm-start a 3000-iteration mechanism-aware HGS refinement with 22 completed archive candidates. The best of the recombined and refined complete solutions is returned.
pass_rule: All six pairs feasible and budget-exact; candidate has zero strict losses and at least two strict wins against control.
stop_rule: If the pass rule fails, preserve HALT evidence and do not tune the split, archive counts, panel, seed, or warm-start count on these observed cases.
claim_boundary: Development gate only; a pass requires a separately frozen confirmation before any formal rerun.
